title: Tunnel B1
overview: Underground. Faster than fear. You have become one with your war machine. Flesh sears. Metal warps. Darkness enfolds you. The tunnel has swallowed you whole. It is alive with the instruments of death. Even the walls want to kill you. The speed hurts. Trigger finger blisters. But it's all you've got. Because the light at the end of the tunnel is a thermonuclear explosion.
